Queensboro Bridge bagels and lox.d: Toasted bagels, whipped cream cheese, sliced Nova, capers, red onion cut thin and fresh dill.

Elaine's crostini.d: French bread rounds, baked crisp. Half with ricotta, lemon peel and honey, half with mushrooms sautéed in garlic and thyme, under Parmesan.
Elaine's crostini.note: Passed on trays at cocktail hour.

Chinese takeaway in bed.d: Diced dark meat stir-fried with dried red peppers, soy, rice wine and Chinese black vinegar, tossed with roasted peanuts and scallions. Steamed rice.
Chinese takeaway in bed.note: Good in front of the late movie.

Worth-living-for cheesecake.d: Rich and dense, lemon and vanilla, buttery crumb crust. Baked slow, chilled overnight. Serves ten.
Worth-living-for cheesecake.note: Worth living for, say our regulars.

Manhattan cocktail.d: Rye, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred with ice, poured straight up over a cherry. Serves eight.
